Oneliner

Design and implement a satellite that will handle basic capabilities and operations.
Description

Design and implement a satellite that will handle basic capabilities and operations. In addition, this satellite has a system that will repeat the incoming data that will serve amateurs. The DIGIPEATING MODE on the satellite will allow forwarding of received messages back to earth to support communication and messaging between radio amateurs (Digital QSOs). The telemetry information will be shared to all radio amateurs and networks before launch.

Analysis of the ADCS system operating status and the efficiency of the power system with data from the IMU sensor. We anticipate that amateurs can work on receiving telemetry data and sending telecoms over this satellite and analyzing doppler effects in this regard. There is only one command to be uplinked to turn off the satellite if needed. In addition, this satellite has a system that will repeat the incoming data that will serve amateurs.

The DIGIPEATING MODE on the satellite will allow forwarding of received messages back to earth to support communication and messaging between radio amateurs (Digital QSOs). The telemetry information will be shared to all radio amateurs and networks before launch.
